text: Supports over a dozen platforms officially, with more community-built SDKs available
quote: Rollbar supports over a dozen platforms, and our community has built many more.

text: Groups occurrences caused by the same error into a single item representing one application issue
quote: Rollbar aggregates _Occurrences_ caused by the same error into _Items_ that represent application issues.

text: Custom fingerprinting rules let you override how the default grouping algorithm combines or separates occurrences
quote: If our default grouping algorithm is separating occurrences that you would rather have combined or vice versa, then you can set up Custom Fingerprinting Rules.

text: Merges multiple items into one group for easier management and more accurate metrics
quote: Item merging allows you to combine multiple items into one 'group' for easier management and more accurate metrics.

text: Uses uploaded JavaScript source maps so minified stack traces show the original source file, line, and method
quote: If you minify your JavaScript code, you need to provide Rollbar with access to your source maps to understand your items' stack traces

text: Shows which versions of your code are throwing exceptions
quote: Rollbar allows you to see which versions of your code are throwing exceptions.

text: Deploy and release notifications unlock extra debugging features tied to deploys
quote: If you notify Rollbar every time you deploy or release your app, you'll unlock several features that will help your debugging process.

text: Sends real-time error alerts by email and through messaging and incident management tools
quote: Rollbar supports email and many messaging and incident management tools where your team can get notified about errors and important events by real-time alerts.

text: Slack integration for sending notifications to Slack
quote: Click **Connect with Slack**

text: Creates, updates, and resolves incidents in PagerDuty
quote: Rollbar can create, update, and resolve Incidents in PagerDuty.

text: Webhooks push data to any external service, using the same triggers as the other notification channels
quote: You can set up webhooks to make Rollbar push data to any arbitrary external service. Webhooks can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels

text: Webhook destination URL and payload format (JSON or XML) can be customized
quote: the destination URL and format (JSON, XML) can be customized, allowing for integration with either your own custom tool/stack, or a third-party service

text: Webhook alerts can be routed through Hookdeck and displayed in Discord
quote: Using Rollbar's Webhooks integration, we can send alerts to Hookdeck, which then formats them for display in your team's Discord server.

text: Items have statuses (Active, Resolved, Muted, Archived) for triage
quote: There are four statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived.

text: A specific user can be assigned as the owner of an item
quote: Items can have a specific Rollbar user designated as the Owner of an item.

text: RESTful API gives access to much of the system's data and is used by the official SDKs
quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system. It is used by our official SDKs to report errors/exceptions, deploys, and other mes

text: API supports listing items filtered by level and environment, with pagination
quote: Get the first page of items that are error or critical, in the production environment

text: Downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec covers the Item, Occurrence, Metrics, and Deploy API resources
quote: docs.rollbar.com/openapi ("All OpenAPI Files") links this downloadable machine-readable document: {"openapi":"3.1.0","servers":[{"url":"https://api.rollbar.com"}],"tags":[{"name":"Item"},{"name":"Occurrence"},{"name":"Metrics"},{"name":"Dep

text: The API can be used to build notifiers for additional languages and to integrate with other systems
quote: It can be used to create notifiers for additional languages, get data out to integrate with other systems, or whatever else you can imagine.

text: Newly created access tokens are encrypted and cannot be viewed again in the UI or API after creation
quote: Newly created tokens will now be encrypted and will no longer be accessible via the UI or API after creation.

text: Client-side tokens limited to the post_client_item scope can only send events and cannot read data
quote: The client-side access token can only be used to send events and only from client-side platforms. It can't be used to read any data

text: Access tokens can be disabled and replaced at any time if abused
quote: Tokens can be disabled and replaced at any time. If someone is abusing your token, you can disable it and use a new one instead.

text: Resolve, an AI agent, takes a production error, writes a tested fix, and opens a pull request for approval
quote: Resolve writes a tested fix and opens the pull request for you to approve.

text: Official MCP server runs over stdio so AI tools like Claude or Cursor can connect to Rollbar
quote: This MCP server implements the `stdio` server type, which means your AI tool (e.g. Claude, Cursor) will run it directly

text: Data retention period can be customized on all paid plans
quote: Rollbar data retention period can be customized on all paid plans.

text: Tracks which users (People) are affected by each error
quote: Rollbar can track which of your People (users) are affected by each error.

text: Free tier includes 5K occurrences and 1K sessions, plus a 14-day full-access trial
quote:
5K occurrences + 1K sessions

Real-time feed and alerts

Intelligent error grouping

Stack traces and telemetry

Deploy and version tracking

text: Telemetry timeline records breadcrumb events to help debug client-side JavaScript
quote: The telemetry timeline provides a list of “breadcrumbs” events that can help developers understand and fix problems in their client-side javascript.

text: Advanced search filters items by many different properties
quote: Advanced search: Filter items by many different properties.

text: Session Replay (beta) captures and replays user sessions around errors
quote: Session Replay is now available in beta! This feature captures and replays user sessions around errors

text: Rollbar.js supports server-side and client-side JavaScript, including React, Angular, Express, and Next.js
quote: Cross platform: Rollbar.js supports both server-side and client-side Javascript, including frameworks such as React, Angular, Express, Next.js and more.

text: Magento2 module automatically reports all PHP errors and exceptions
quote: The module should automatically report all PHP errors and exceptions in your Magento2 app.

text: .NET SDK major version adds Blazor client-side support
quote: The primary motivation for making another major version of the SDK is the addition of Blazor Client-Side support.

text: Captures Apple Unified Logging entries as Rollbar telemetry log events
quote: This module implements RollbarNotifier integration with Apple Unified Logging (AUL) and allows capture of the AUL entries as corresponding Rollbar Telemetry log events.

text: Ruby gem can write payloads to a file for async forwarding by rollbar-agent instead of sending them directly
quote: you can configure the gem to write to a file instead of sending the payload to Rollbar servers directly. rollbar-agent can then be hooked up to this file

text: SDK can store payloads in a local offline store
quote: offlineStoreOptions.EnableLocalPayloadStore = true;

text: Notifier exposes an InternalEvent hook that reports Rollbar's internal SDK events
quote: Subscribe to its InternalEvent event... at runtime, all the Rollbar internal events generated while using any instance of the Notifier will be reported into the event handler.

text: SDK LTS releases ship roughly every twelve months, each supported for eighteen months
quote: These LTS releases follow a separate, enterprise-focused track of scheduled major version releases roughly every twelve months with support lasting eighteen months

text: Item detail page warns when the SDK in use is out of date
quote: When viewing an item in the Item Detail Page you will see a notification if your SDK is out of date.

text: Terraform provider for managing Rollbar configuration as code
quote: Make error tracking and deployment quality a part of every project with our [Terraform provi

text: Connects errors, replays, and releases in one place and points to the code behind each error
quote: connects errors, replays, and releases in one place, and points you to the code behind each error.
